author: t.wambsgans
content:
- Starting from now the binding sources are in leanVM (see this [README](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/tree/main/bindings#readme)). The aggregation/verification is no no longer in-process, it sends requests to a sidecar that must be running alongside.
- The VRF tree [PR](https://github.com/leanEthereum/leanVM/pull/805) is ready on leanVM (with bindings). I will wait for the spec to include the secret preimages to merge it. It comes with caching and pruning. That should solve your issue for the testnet <@412614104222531604>  -> only generate 2^20 slots.

author: barnabasbusa
content: the pr does not check the loaded bytes against the public key, so a wrong or stale file gives invalid signatures instead of a load error
